blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Itban ibn Malik (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “A person who has testified that there is none worthy of worship except Allah and that I (Muhammad ﷺ) am the Messenger of Allah will neither enter the Fire, nor will the fire of Jahannam consume him.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيه ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ شَهِدَ أَنْ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَنْ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ فَذَلَّ بِهَا لِسَانُهُ وَاطْمَأَنَّ بِهَا قَلْبُهُ لَمْ تَطْعَمْهُ النَّارُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Qatadah (RA) narrates through his father that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever testifies that there is no god but Allah and that I (Muhammad ﷺ) am the Messenger of Allah, and his tongue becomes accustomed to this Kalimah (Tayyibah) and his heart finds peace in this Kalimah, the fire of Jahannam will not touch him.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا مِنْ نَفْسٍ تَمُوتُ وَهِيَ تَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللهِ يَرْجِعُ ذلِكَ إِليَ قَلْبٍ مُوقِنٍ إِلَّا غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهَا.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whichever person dies in the state of having testified, with a heart full of certainty, that there is none worthy of worship except Allah and that I am the Rasul of Allah, Allah will certainly forgive him.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ وَمُعَاذٌ رَدِيفُهُ عَلَي الرَّحْلِ قَالَ: يَامُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ؟ قَالَ: لَبَّيْكَ يَارَسُولَ اللهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ
